capture.scrollbarMode: Measured directly; no overlay/non-overlay assumption is encoded.

cases.name: vertical_auto_tall_child
cases.purpose: Vertical overflow-y:auto with a tall child; checks scrollTop setters, scrollTo, scrollBy, and end clamping.
unsupported: RTL scrollLeft conventions and vertical writing modes are not covered.
User-driven wheel, touch, keyboard, and scrollbar dragging are not covered.
Scroll snapping, smooth animation, and scroll anchoring are not covered.
